name: Rich TeX Editor
description: A rich LaTeX editor for .tex files: a visual mode that renders math, headings, tables, images and TikZ pictures (drawn by your own TeX) as you type, a split mode with a live preview, and drag-and-drop images.

cover.alt: Rich TeX Editor in visual mode: a LaTeX paper with a typeset title, numbered sections, KaTeX equations and resolved references.

screenshots.alt: Visual mode: headings, bold and italic text, inline and display math rendered in place, with references shown as numbers.
screenshots.caption: Visual mode renders the document as you type; put the cursor on anything to edit its source.

screenshots.alt: Visual mode with a numbered theorem, an aligned equation, a rendered table and a figure drawn in place.
screenshots.caption: Tables, theorems and figures are drawn in place; drop an image to add one.

screenshots.alt: Split mode in a dark theme: LaTeX source with line numbers beside a live preview with a theorem, an aligned equation and a table.
screenshots.caption: Split mode: source beside a live preview that scrolls with it.
